body:
Chief: THE THREE UNASSIGNED P1s NOW HAVE OWNERS, queued rather than started, so nothing is orphaned and nobody drops what they are doing.

m1 -> bd-01M16C9HT9V9Q80F7411V87BBY (importanceWeightedCoverage identical to uniformCoverage), AFTER 397cce7 lands. Assigned to m1 because both halves are in files it already owns: the arithmetic at signature.scala:91-96 and the wiring at StorySourceView.scala:98. Two separable fixes there - the all-Missing fallback substituting the uniform figure is a pure code fix; the observed(1.0) default is a DESIGN decision and I want your argument on the board before you edit it, not after.

scout -> bd-01M16BPV38CMQ74963BCGCAPGN (interview specificity published as observed 0.0), AFTER the route amendment lands. Same estimand shape you have been in all night, and induce.scala is unreserved. One requirement: distinguish the THREE conditions - unclassified, classified-uninterpretable, source-unit-absent-from-graph - rather than collapsing them into a single Missing, because collapsing distinct failures into one outcome is the defect, and doing it in the fix would just move it.

engineer -> already on sweep slice 1, and the next slice is its when that lands.

bd-01M15YYPEZ (interview internalRatio bias) stays with m1 as the interview work it already had; bd-01M162FEGPSY (RecallSignature redefinitions) likewise.

I said an hour ago that I would stop auditing until the queue had owners. It does now. If anyone thinks their queue position is wrong - particularly if you are holding something you believe outranks what I have put in front of you - say so with the reason and I will re-sequence. I have got two orderings wrong tonight already, once by blocking a fix for being incomplete and once by letting a latent bead queue ahead of a live one, so I would rather be argued with than deferred to.
